_about: D01-D46 family status (roadmap 3.2, dispositions per 1.3). generate.js verifies every evidence path exists and evaluates every metric against this baseline's scan. A row whose evidence fails to resolve is reported as UNVERIFIED rather than trusted. Umbrella status only; the atomic ledger (roadmap 25) is later work.

families.name: Identity/account
families.finding: Network is a real OAuth2/OIDC IdP; Live keeps its own users table and Community translates identity through Live.

families.name: Registry, capabilities, contracts
families.finding: Three partial registries (url_registry, Tools catalog, Sites catalog); contracts are prose in CONTRACTS.md; no capability layer.

families.name: Policy, staff, user modules
families.finding: Roles and admin exist per service; no shared capability map; versioned user modules do not exist.

families.name: Themes, notifications, social, analytics
families.finding: Themes and notifications are shared and real; follows exist in both Live and Network; analytics is per site with no retention.

families.name: Events, realtime, SDK
families.finding: Cross-service effects are direct internal POSTs and HMAC webhooks; every realtime channel is a product-local WebSocket server; no SDK.

families.name: Media
families.finding: Real service with B2/R2 tiering; predecessor-shaped vods/clips/files tables, still owns paste semantics.

families.name: Live, OpenRe, channel/VOD lineage
families.finding: Live owns RTMP/WHIP/WebRTC ingest and restream in-process.

families.name: Chat
families.finding: Rooms, DMs, TTS, soundboard, calls and moderation work, all as a Live module.

families.name: Community
families.finding: SSR paste pages only; no database; comments live in Live, paste semantics in Media and (frozen) Live.

families.name: Billing, Tips, VIP
families.finding: Money split across Network (OpenCoins wallet) and Live (Vibes/PayPal, subscriptions); no ledger authority or reconciliation.

families.name: Tools
families.finding: Gateway plus 7 satellites running; shared jobs/media primitives absent.

families.name: Games
families.finding: Authoritative world with Network SSO; not on shared chrome, no mod platform.

families.name: Codes, Host
families.finding: Charter repositories only.

families.name: AI, content, sources, search
families.finding: Large AI subsystem inside Live; no source registry, search index or publishing runtime.

families.name: Mods
families.finding: No mod manifest, grants or sandbox in the platform (Source.OpenVibe.Games has its own runtime, not audited here).

families.name: Open developer services
families.finding: Only a first-party PowerChat integration; internal calls use shared loopback keys.

families.name: Independent runtime lifecycle
families.finding: Repos deploy independently and Live is socket-activated, but Live restarts drop RTMP and Media restarts orphan recordings.

families.name: Shared component architecture
families.finding: openvibe-shared is a tagged OpenVibe.Shared release that consumers pin in package.json; a consumer can lag the newest tag or still carry a vendored copy.

families.name: Safe active-client updates
families.finding: Live has a deploy notice and content-hashed assets; no release manifests or update coordinator.

families.name: Crawlable component rendering
families.finding: SSR/static with metadata in Network, Tools, Media, Community and Sites.

families.name: Release compatibility and recovery
families.finding: Deploy is git pull + restart; no versioned releases or mixed-version policy.

families.name: Update observability and acceptance
families.finding: No CI outside AFResume; no release telemetry.
